description: adopt qiqi_delegate 0.2 semantically self-sufficient immutable TaskPacket snapshots: Work Item stays on the QiQi/orchestration side, user_request and normal verification are removed from the child-facing schema, context separates trusted_facts from claims_to_investigate with an exact typed public MCP input schema, empty optional prompt sections are omitted, stale-result handling belongs to QiQi, Shared Knowledge remains available only for legitimate implementation/domain knowledge rather than reconstructing missing task semantics, Codex routes the qiqi_delegate namespace as a direct-only Code Mode tool so synchronous delegation does not fall through exec-cell wait polling that repeatedly resamples the parent model, QiQi keeps orchestration/stable-policy meta-instructions such as Work Item handling, verification-strategy ownership, delegation mechanics, and polling policy out of child constraints unless the method itself is a material user/product/system requirement, and normal Work Item completion uses the delegated revision as an optimistic-CAS stale guard so an uncontended post-child path can update directly without a redundant reread while revision conflict forces latest-state materiality reconciliation; rerun work-item-template/scripts/install-user-mcp.sh after migration and open fresh QiQi/child sessions so the new MCP/skill/tool-routing contract is discovered
